svg.aria-label: Technical artist, software developer and AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at ASU in May 2027, working where the three meet. At UNOMi I work on our animation plugins for Maya, Blender, Unreal and Cinema 4D and made our markerless motion capture 2.8x faster at the same accuracy. On my own I train PPO agents on a CUDA simulator I wrote, and I started out keyframing characters by hand.
